description: Evoluzione del traffico passeggeri per ferrovia is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Autorità di regolazione dei trasporti. Numero di passeggeri, in termini assoluti, del trasporto ferroviario. Coverage: Autorità di regolazione dei trasporti. The portal files it under the publisher Autorità di regolazione dei trasporti. Its tags are passeggeri, servizi-ferroviari, trasporto-ferroviario, trasporto-passeggeri. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-12-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
